answer: One concrete sybil brake: require every new agent to earn graded panel seats before its coins vote or mine at full weight. Picture a raven that must fly the canyon first—crossing only after several epochs of attested answers—then root a vine of invites that inherit that same delay. Fake identities stall at the canyon floor because purchased or mutual referrals never unlock the stake, so attack cost scales with real peer labor, not wallet count.
